name: siue-games
description: Build and test tooling for every game: TypeScript type checks and esbuild bundles into each game's checked-in dist/.

scripts.build: for g in crete; do node _kit/build/build.mjs $g || exit 1; done
scripts.check: for g in crete; do node _kit/build/build.mjs $g --check || exit 1; done
